title: [Shopify] Tax matching fixes for country, Canadian HST, and zero-rate lines
summary: The Shopify Tax Matching Agent now correctly handles North American orders by restricting to US and Canadian orders, scoping Canadian HST/TVH jurisdictions to provinces, matching zero-rate tax lines, and improving the matching algorithm with updated keyword rules and prompt consistency.
key_points: Tax matching restricted to US and Canadian orders only
Canadian HST/TVH jurisdictions scoped by province (e.g., ONHST, NSHST) to prevent rate conflicts across provinces
Zero-rate tax lines now matched like other lines instead of remaining unmatched
Matching prompt updated with consistent keyword rules, French jurisdiction names, and improved geographic scoping
Tax Match Review experience updated to show 0% rates as 0.00 and preserve full Shopify tax titles when creating jurisdictions
quote: Fix Shopify Tax Matching Agent behavior for supported North American orders
